disposition: Freeze before the first official run. Run every panel to completion with the shipped solver and record all outcomes.
straight: 8 fresh 64-bit resets, one uniform command in each equal-width stratum of 4.5 to 5.5 metres. Exact public practice command 5 m.
right_turn: 8 fresh 64-bit resets, one uniform magnitude in each equal-width stratum of 75 to 105 degrees, clockwise signed negative. Exact public practice command -90 degrees.
raw: strict native stops / all 16 scheduled trials, including every timeout, fall, path violation and rejected solver episode. No time or token charge in the reward.
N0: Official ale validate with null anchor. Its default oracle's successful-stop count n0 establishes the denominator n0 / 16.
N1_N2_N3: Three additional fresh official oracle runs, no outcome-triggered retry or substitutions. Keep all per-route raw counts and sensitivity, native time, code, smoothness and foot-contact measurements.
full_credit_count: max(12, min(n0,n1,n2,n3)-1). The one-episode margin allows a fresh start of sampling variation. The 12/16 floor keeps full credit out of reach for methods solving only one route family.
full_at: full_credit_count / n0. If n0 is zero, the reference misses either route family, the cap of 1.5 is exceeded, or the floor is demonstrably unattainable, retain the outcome as an inadmissible reference version.
G0_G1: Two fresh official ale validate invocations on exactly the final anchor and task. Neither may alter normalization, source, thresholds, or case selection.
feedback: Eight hidden time bands compare real public input with a prior native measurement (8 to 30 control ticks old) rebased to the current tick, holding the original world goal fixed. One identical-input repeat/trial estimates action noise. Two route-progress observations provide other reachable distances or angles of the same course family on the very same physical observation. Both net response fractions must be at least 0.10, with >=16 real history comparisons and >=8 identical-input and same-family-goal comparisons per 16 trials. Across-family probes are reported separately.
